confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. July is Phuket's low monsoon season, so accommodation uses low-season rates including typical Thai VAT and service charges. Coffee and cheap-meal anchors are the most reliable; the 3-star hotel, mid-range meal and private hostel anchors have the widest ranges. Cocktail and wine are set from the draft beer anchor (about 2.2x and 2x) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX value is from RBA exchange-rate listings returned by web search and was not re-opened on rba.gov.au; cached timestamps were inconsistent and search summaries also report 0.6955 for 15 Oct 2026, so verify the 16 Oct value against the live table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; based on general knowledge of Thai beach-resort pricing (similar to tourist areas such as Pattaya and Koh Samui), adjusted to Phuket's Patong, Kata and Karon accommodation and dining levels. City prices were not searched.
